reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, linkBankSyncAccount and the existing import pipeline, although local unlink cleanup is copied rather than extracted for reuse.

duplication.why: The change duplicates the Akahu transaction downloader, account-list request, unlink field reset and linked-account selection predicate.

placement.why: Link policy and database operations live in accounts/link.ts, orchestration remains in accounts/app.ts, and provider downloads remain in accounts/sync.ts.

scope.why: Most edits support the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, but the additional account-list endpoint and schedules import reorder exceed the stated requirements.

maintainability.why: Shared linking orchestration limits provider divergence, but copied transport and unlink logic plus duplicated holder predicates create avoidable maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra uses the existing bank lookup and linking abstractions; unlinkAccount includes remote cleanup, so it is not directly suitable for local link replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/link.ts repeats the holder-selection query using first/upgradingId versus all/keepId, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadAkahuTransactions with renamed provider details and simplified result variables.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink adds one shared option, an early return in assertBankAccountNotLinked and conditional release in linkBankSyncAccount; the assertion also acquires closed-target validation despite its narrower name, while all six providers use the shared policy.
